One or two storms near dawn could be on the strong side, but the overall severe threat appears limited. 💨 Behind the front, expect a blustery and noticeably cooler start to the week with highs mainly in the 50s Monday and Tuesday. 📈 A warming trend should then take hold, with temperatures rebounding toward more springlike levels by midweek. 📢 Read the full forecast and timing details at CWG.LiveCapital Weather Gang50.7K views · March 220:06Fireball observed from PittsburghCapital Weather Gang83.5K views · March 180:10Big El Nino coming up for next fall and winter? This is something meteorologists are watching. Some weather modeling is predicting a historically intense El Nino developing by the fall or winter. Big El Nino winters tend to be feast or famine for snow in DC. We can get hammered with a massive snowstorm (like in 2016) or it can be too warm and we get mostly rain (see 1998). While there is already El Nino hype starting to build, its intensity and even its presence is notoriously difficult to predict... especially this far out... So stay tuned.
